description: Na₅MgBiO₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.30 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.52 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.42 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.05 Å. Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.48 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal bipyramidal geometry to four Na and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mg atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom.
